skill.displayName: 商誉减值测试底稿核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The skill mostly performs the advertised local goodwill-impairment worksheet checks, but it also embeds under-disclosed paid-upgrade/payment instructions and local upsell tracking that users should review before installing.

dimensions.detail: Allowed tools are Read and Bash, which are proportionate to running the local Node checker and reading input files. The runner reads session-related environment variables only for upsell suppression/tracking, which is not necessary for the worksheet analysis itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is a local skill with Markdown instructions, a Node runner, a bundled engine, and a sample JSON file. No dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or external package source was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions go beyond worksheet checking by directing downstream agents to relay commercial prompts and handle an upgrade purchase path. The instructions include user-control language and say the result must be delivered first, but the monetization flow is mandatory to present and is not cleanly scoped in the main description.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The runner writes a timestamp marker in the system temp directory to limit how often the upsell prompt appears, using a marker name copied from a payroll-check skill. This creates disclosed-in-code but under-disclosed local persistence unrelated to the accounting check.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core engine is purpose-aligned: it parses goodwill impairment worksheet text and performs the advertised arithmetic, total, duplicate, and blank-field checks. However, the skill also requires an agent to present a paid full-version choice after each free run and to proceed with a purchase-link or QR-code flow if the user selects it, which is not aligned with the top-level 'no payment' framing.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a free local accounting checker that also presents a paid-upgrade prompt. Treat any payment link or QR code as a separate transaction, verify platform billing rules and merchant details yourself, and consider disabling the upsell with SKILL_NO_UPSELL=1 if you only want the local checker.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Partly accepted: the main goodwill-check functionality is coherent, but the promise that every finding cites original text is overstated because findings cite normalized values and computed results, and reused share-based-payment wording appears in comments and an empty-input error.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted in part: there are real description/behavior mismatches, including top-level no-payment/no-network framing alongside paid-upgrade instructions, copied share-based-payment text in the engine, and a payroll-check marker name in the runner.
[AE1] expected: Overridden: the referenced scripts/run.mjs artifact was present in the workspace and was inspected completely for this adjudication.
[LP1] unexpected: Accepted: the runner reads session and upsell environment variables for commercial prompt control, which is not needed for the core worksheet-checking purpose.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted: the skill embeds a commercial upgrade and payment-link/QR-code flow in both SKILL.md and runtime output despite being presented primarily as a free local checker.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted in part: the purchase-handling instructions and temp-file prompt marker add transactional behavior and local state outside the core analysis function; no exfiltration or destructive behavior was found.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-language interface is consistent with the Chinese accounting-workpaper domain and is not by itself a security concern, though English users may find the skill hard to use.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Accepted: the temp marker used for upsell frequency control is not prominently disclosed in the primary help or skill summary.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The A.I.G scan reported no results; independent inspection still found the under-disclosed upsell, payment-flow, and temp-marker concerns described above.
